title: crash/SIGSEGV on second call to :checkhealth

labels.name: bug-crash
labels.description: issue reporting a crash or segfault

body:
### Neovim version (nvim -v)

`NVIM v0.9.0-dev` it's nightly from nix so, maybe 090048bec9f80c46a6ce6ff05a419b15bc4bf028 but hard to tell without pr #21210 

### Vim (not Nvim) behaves the same?

no, needs lua

### Operating system/version

macOS 12.6.1

### Terminal name/version

iTerm2 Build 3.5.0beta7

### $TERM environment variable

xterm-256color

### Installation

nix nightly flake

### How to reproduce the issue

I couldn’t figure out how to get all the lua requires to work with `nvim --clean` sorry. I got as far as `:lua package.path = package.path .. ";/tmp/noice.nvim/lua/?/init.lua;/tmp/nui/lua/?/init.lua"` but can't figure out how to get noice to actually require under `--clean`

Using `nvim -u NONE` and these versions, installed from packer

```
noice e013b6ebbad0fab34013be6f073da38c53c9e1dc
nui 2a6533fb798efad7dd783311315bab8dc5eb381b
```

Then run the same missing health check twice:

```
:lua require('noice').setup()
:checkhealth a
:checkhealth a
```

 

### Expected behavior

```
==============================================================================
a: 

- ERROR No healthcheck found for "a" plugin.
```

both times

### Actual behavior

The first time you get `ERROR No healthcheck found for "a" plugin.` but the second time you get a segfault


```
      fish: Job 1, 'nvim' terminated by signal SIGSEGV (Address boundary error)
```
